note: No .env file is committed, only .env.defaults with empty values. Gemini is called only from server code, and the key goes to bots through event.secrets. Booking has a real confirm step in the UI and the server re-checks slot, schedule, specialty and summary before $book. labels.what: check_availability returns slots from a schedule the app invents for a real NPPES doctor. The tool description (line 55) and prompt call them real bookable times. The doctor's office has no part in it

Weekly working days and hours for each doctor are made up from a hash of the NPI (4 day patterns, start 8 to 10). The Schedule built from them at lines 164-177 is shown to patients as real availability
Shows Appointment Confirmed with a real doctor name and NPI. The booking exists only in the demo Medplum project against an invented schedule. No clinic or doctor is told

Booking prompt says never diagnose, speculate about a condition, suggest treatment or triage. The free-text replies returned to the patient get no output check. The patient-chat path runs containsInterpretationLanguage but booking chat does not
Same no-diagnosis rule. The model-written reason and pre-visit summary from propose_options are saved to the patient record with only an empty-string check, no content check

Prompt says never state a provider or time exists unless check_availability returned it. Picks are grounded in code, but plain-text assistant replies are returned with no grounding check, so the model can name doctors or times in prose
Tool schema limits windowDays to 1-14 and startOffsetDays to 0 or more. checkAvailabilityTool uses the model values as-is with no clamp, so a large window or negative offset goes straight to $find

propose_options writes the model's reason and pre-visit summary into the patient record. At booking it becomes the appointment description and is marked sent to the doctor. The patient confirms the slot but never sees or approves this text

All visitors share one demo ClientApplication via one access code. execute only checks the token belongs to that shared client. Anyone with the code can chat as any patient, book for any patientId, and cancel, complete or reschedule any demo appointment
Doctor desk identity is a typed NPI that the page itself calls not identity verification. Anyone can open any doctor's queue and ask the AI about the full record of that doctor's patients
Every visitor sees a list of 50 patients and can open any one to chat and book under that patient's record. No patient login
Cancel only checks the demo tag and status, not that the caller owns the appointment. complete-appointment.ts and reschedule-appointment.ts have the same gap

agent-ensure-doctor is in ALLOWED_ACTIONS, so the browser can call it. It takes a client-supplied NPI and candidate (name, specialty, state) and creates Practitioner, PractitionerRole and Schedule records with no check against NPPES. This skips the provenance gate the booking chat uses
No rate limit or per-session quota on the paid Gemini actions. One booking turn can make up to 8 model calls, each with up to 4 retries. README line 218 says there is intentionally no rate limiter
The shared access code is the only gate and can be guessed with no attempt limit or lockout

Every doctor question sends the whole patient record ($everything, up to 6 MB) to Gemini, a third-party model. No data minimization. The repo says data is synthetic, but the path is built for real records
NPI is put into the NPPES query string with no encoding. It can come from client input through agent-ensure-doctor
Medplum access token is kept in sessionStorage, readable by any script on the page

The browser client is only checked to be read-only, not limited by resource or patient. The app reads every patient, appointment and AI transcript from the browser, so any visitor can read the whole project. The AccessPolicy itself is not in the repo
The whole patient and doctor population is 983 Synthea synthetic bundles in fhir/. Seeded doctors carry fake NPIs such as 290, which is why the doctor desk accepts 1 to 10 digit NPIs
Hand-written disease-to-specialty table assigns specialties to the synthetic doctors. This drives the previously-seen doctor match
Gemini retry delays 1, 4, 16 and 60 seconds. The 60 s wait alone reaches the 60 s function maxDuration in vercel.json, so the last retry can never finish
Model name gemini-3.5-flash-lite hardcoded here and again in geminiRequest.ts line 1
NPPES candidate cap is 10 here, 15 in the booking chat tool (NPPES_SEARCH_LIMIT) and a default of 20 in nppes.ts line 128
Option cap defaults to 3 here while MAX_BOOKABLE_OPTIONS is 8
Dev server bound to localhost port 3000
